name: route-source-order-and-unconfigured-sources
description: The route lists sources tool_results then request_system, so the tool item comes first. request_context and extension are not route sources: the pasted <context> block is dropped but still removed from user_request, and trustagent.context adds no item (the trustagent member is still stripped from the forwarded body). pre_dedup_items counts configured sources only: 2.
